statements: <HOME>\meta\installation.json has minimum logical fields installation_schema_version, installation_id, state_root and created_at. Version must be explicit/supported. installation_id is opaque, generated once during fresh offline init, independent of APP_ROOT, username, machine name and port, and preserved on ordinary init rerun, app upgrade and relocation. UUID encoding is not mandated. P4 restore keeps destination identity; source identity is provenance only. Source PID/ownership and absolute path mapping never become active destination authority. Incompatible metadata fails closed without mutation/migration.

field_meanings.installation_id: stable opaque ID, one per initialized installation
field_meanings.state_root: canonical resolved absolute local state mapping
field_meanings.created_at: original installation creation timestamp, preserved on ordinary init rerun/upgrade/relocation
